pyqgis_plugin.name: Chronicle Workbench
pyqgis_plugin.description: Move cemetery data between Chronicle databases, from one toolbar.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A toolbar for the mapping workflow: bring a cemetery into the GIS database (upload a backup, or pull it from Chronicle), put it on the QGIS canvas, edit it there or on a Chronicle-style preview, put a change back, undo an upload, and back the cemetery up. Everything it needs is inside it — the tunnel and the GIS database go under Settings.
